title: Handbook of the Falchion Step-and-Chop
summary: Joins a qi-fed advancing step to the falchion chop for students who already hold the Basic falchion primers.

title: Treatise on the Belly-Drag Cut
summary: Explains how to feed qi along the curved belly of the falchion for long, pulled cuts that open guards.

title: A Drill-Book of the Cleaver Guard
summary: Trains the broad blade as a qi-backed guard that turns heavy cuts and answers them in a single motion.

title: Canon of the Qi-Weighted Swell
summary: Teaches the warrior to gather qi in the swollen forward part of the blade so each chop lands with extra mass.

title: Treatise on Falchion Counter-Chops
summary: Sets out the parries and answering chops by which a falchion user takes back the initiative from a heavier blow.

title: Handbook of the Hacking Press
summary: Teaches a relentless forward press of linked hacks that drives an opponent back across the ground with the falchion.

title: Manual of Heavy Blade Binding
summary: Shows how the weight and spine of the falchion can pin, trap and press down an opposing weapon.

title: Workbook of the Sweeping Clip
summary: Drills the wide sweeping cuts and the clipped forward edge that let a falchion user cover a broad arc.

title: Treatise of the Chop and Turn
summary: Teaches the warrior to chop, turn off the line and chop again, with qi smoothing each turn of the heavy blade.
